arc_catalyst.sun: Directed Sun arrives as recognition. Something in this pairing is brought into the light and made central - identified with, owned, put at the heart of the year rather than kept at its edges.
arc_catalyst.moon: Directed Moon arrives as need. This pairing stops being an idea and becomes something felt: wanted, missed, responded to in the body and in the household rather than reasoned about.
arc_catalyst.mercury: Directed Mercury arrives as the conversation. This pairing gets said out loud, written down, negotiated or arranged - the news about it, the paperwork of it, the sentence that names what had been unspoken.
arc_catalyst.venus: Directed Venus arrives as value. This pairing becomes something wanted and worth having, and so something to be joined, bought, reconciled or made agreeable. What it is worth to you is the question it asks.
arc_catalyst.mars: Directed Mars arrives as action. This pairing is pushed at: begun, fought for, cut away from. It is the layer at which something is finally done about the matter, well or badly.
arc_catalyst.jupiter: Directed Jupiter arrives as permission. This pairing is enlarged and sanctioned - given room, approval, scope or a yes. Its risk is the same as its gift: more of whatever was already there.
arc_catalyst.saturn: Directed Saturn arrives as cost. This pairing is tested, formalised and made to account for itself. What holds is kept and given a structure; what was carried on goodwill is asked to stand on its own.
arc_catalyst.uranus: Directed Uranus arrives as interruption. This pairing is broken open rather than developed - done suddenly, differently, and often from outside the plan. Freedom and disruption are one event here.
arc_catalyst.neptune: Directed Neptune arrives as dissolution. This pairing loses its edges: idealised, blurred, given away or quietly let go. What it gains in meaning it loses in definition.
arc_catalyst.pluto: Directed Pluto arrives as compulsion. This pairing is stripped to what it actually is, and the process is not optional. Something in it is buried, and something is exhumed.
arc_catalyst.north_node: Directed North Node arrives as direction. This pairing becomes the way forward rather than a place to return to - taken up, leaned into, made the thing that is being grown rather than the thing being kept.
arc_catalyst.ascendant: Directed Ascendant arrives in the body and the bearing. This pairing becomes how you meet people and how they meet you - carried in the manner, the health and the first impression rather than in the circumstances.
arc_catalyst.mc: Directed MC arrives as public standing. This pairing becomes visible, official and on the record - a matter of what you are known for and answerable to rather than what you privately hold.

arc_picture.uranus_sun_moon: The classical reading: a sudden re-orientation of the whole life. Sun/Moon is the chart's own centre of gravity - the fused point of identity and need, which is why it is the midpoint cosmobiology watches first. Uranus arriving there is read as an urge for personal freedom strong enough to rearrange the arrangements: a move, a separation, a decision that surprises the people around it more than the person making it. Ebertin's catalogue puts partnership separation here, and that is one outcome rather than the meaning - the meaning is that the centre moves.
arc_picture.pluto_sun_saturn: The classical reading: structural pressure that does not negotiate. Sun/Saturn is vitality under obligation - what it costs to be who you are. Pluto arriving there is read as a period of intense pressure on exactly that: isolation, a health matter that insists on being taken seriously, or a career restructured from underneath rather than reformed from within. It is the picture most often found behind the years people describe as having been put through something.
arc_picture.jupiter_sun_mc: The classical reading: recognition arriving in public. Sun/MC fuses identity with standing - who you are and what you are known for. Jupiter arriving there is read as the moment that pairing is sanctioned: a public achievement, a title, an audience, a long-held career goal reached. It is one of the few pictures in the catalogue whose plain reading is good news, and it is still worth asking what the natal chart promised before writing it as such.
arc_picture.uranus_mars_pluto: The classical reading: force, suddenly. Mars/Pluto is already the chart's most concentrated pairing - will fused with compulsion - and Uranus arriving there is read as that concentration released without warning. Ebertin's wording is the blunt end of the catalogue: extreme force, violent or accidental events, radical transformation. It is also the picture most in need of the natal anchor. Read as a prediction of disaster it is almost always wrong; read as a description of force arriving faster than it can be governed, it is usually recognisable afterwards.
